sources.entry: OpenEMR - Electronic health records and medical practice management solution. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: OpenEMR is a free and open source electronic health records and medical practice management application.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OpenEMR as a free and open source electronic health records (EHR) and medical practice management application. It states that it includes integrated electronic health records, practice management, scheduling, electronic billing, and internationalization. It says the application runs on Windows, Linux, Mac OS X, and many other platforms. The README points to separate documents for the API, Docker setup, FHIR, security reporting, and contributing. It gives build commands for running from the source repository, which use Composer and Node.js.
use_cases: electronic health records for a medical practice
running an EHR on a self-hosted server
FHIR and API integration with health records
notable: Combines EHR, practice management, scheduling, and electronic billing in one application
Supports FHIR and has a documented API
Has ONC certification sponsors mentioned in the README
caveats: The README does not describe hosting requirements beyond the build steps; details are in separate docs
Running from source requires Node.js 24 and Composer build steps
keywords: run ehr on my own server
